nodes.name: alquimia_interface.h
nodes.summary: Defines the engine-neutral AlquimiaData aggregate and the AlquimiaInterface function-pointer contract for setup, reaction stepping, condition processing, metadata, and auxiliary output.
nodes.languageNotes: A C function-pointer table provides runtime engine polymorphism without exposing engine-specific types to drivers.

nodes.name: alquimia_memory.c
nodes.summary: Implements allocation and release helpers for every dynamically sized Alquimia vector, state, metadata, condition, constraint, and aggregate data structure.
nodes.languageNotes: Vector capacities are rounded to powers of two, and paired Allocate/Free routines centralize ownership of nested C allocations.

nodes.name: AllocateAlquimiaVectorDouble
nodes.summary: Allocates a zero-initialized Alquimia double vector with power-of-two capacity while retaining the requested logical size.

nodes.name: FreeAlquimiaVectorDouble
nodes.summary: Releases owned storage held by an Alquimia double vector and clears its dynamically allocated members.

nodes.name: AllocateAlquimiaVectorInt
nodes.summary: Allocates a zero-initialized Alquimia integer vector with power-of-two capacity while retaining the requested logical size.

nodes.name: FreeAlquimiaVectorInt
nodes.summary: Releases owned storage held by an Alquimia integer vector and clears its dynamically allocated members.

nodes.name: AllocateAlquimiaVectorString
nodes.summary: Allocates a string vector and fixed-size character buffers for every requested element.

nodes.name: FreeAlquimiaVectorString
nodes.summary: Releases owned storage held by an Alquimia string vector and clears its dynamically allocated members.

nodes.name: alquimia_util.c
nodes.summary: Provides shared comparison, lookup, deep-copy, resize, and diagnostic printing operations for Alquimia containers and geochemical data structures.
nodes.languageNotes: The utility API applies operation families consistently across primitive vectors and nested geochemical container types.

nodes.name: AlquimiaCaseInsensitiveStringCompare
nodes.summary: Compares two strings without case sensitivity and returns the ordering result used by name-based lookup operations.

nodes.name: AlquimiaFindIndexFromName
nodes.summary: Finds a requested name in an Alquimia string vector using case-insensitive comparison and returns its index or a missing-value sentinel.
